en.title: Spanish NH90 helicopters fly first live NATO scramble in Romania
en.summary: Two NH90 helicopters from the Spanish Air and Space Force's Paznic detachment scrambled from Mihail Kogalniceanu Air Base in Romania on November 6, 2026, in response to unidentified drones, in the first operational scramble involving a Spanish helicopter on an international NATO mission.
body: Two NH90 helicopters from the Spanish Air and Space Force's Paznic tactical air detachment have carried out their first live Alpha scramble in Romania, taking off from Mihail Kogalniceanu Air Base in response to unidentified drones, Spain's Defense Staff (EMAD) said on November 6, 2026. The drones disappeared before the helicopters needed to engage them, and both aircraft returned to base. According to EMAD, it was the first operational scramble involving a Spanish helicopter deployed on an international NATO mission.

The Paznic detachment took over NATO's enhanced Air Policing mission in Romania on July 31, 2026. The Spanish contingent comprises seven F/A-18M Hornet fighters, one A400M tanker, three NH90 helicopters, and approximately 200 personnel, with the deployment scheduled to run until the end of November 2026. When the rotation was announced in late July 2026, NATO said the NH90s would join during the final phase of the deployment, specifically to conduct counter-drone missions. EMAD said the Paznic detachment had conducted 37 Alpha scramble sorties as of November 6, 2026. The deployment has already seen a live engagement: on August 16, a Spanish F/A-18 shot down a drone that entered Romanian airspace from the direction of Moldova.

"They do not replace the F-18s. They complement them," Lieutenant Colonel Alberto B. Calvo Lopez said in the EMAD statement. Lopez explained that while fighters offer speed, range, powerful sensors and rapid response capabilities, helicopters provide greater flexibility against threats flying at low altitudes and speeds or behaving in less conventional ways. The NH90 deployment is part of NATO's broader shift from traditional air policing toward Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), combining fighter patrols, ground-based air defenses and counter-drone capabilities.

zh.title: 西班牙NH90直升機在羅馬尼亞執行北約首次實戰緊急升空
zh.summary: 西班牙空天軍Paznic分遣隊兩架NH90直升機11月6日自羅馬尼亞米哈伊爾科格爾尼恰努空軍基地升空，回應不明無人機；無人機在接戰前消失，兩機返航，為西班牙直升機在國際北約任務中首次作戰緊急升空。
body: 西班牙空天軍Paznic戰術空中分遣隊兩架NH90直升機11月6日自羅馬尼亞米哈伊爾科格爾尼恰努空軍基地升空，執行首次實戰Alpha scramble，回應不明無人機。據西班牙國防參謀部表示，無人機在需要接戰前消失，兩機返回基地；這是西班牙直升機在國際北約任務中首次執行作戰緊急升空。
Paznic分遣隊7月31日接手北約在羅馬尼亞的強化空中警戒任務，編制包括7架F/A-18M大黃蜂戰機、1架A400M加油機、3架NH90直升機與約200名人員，部署至11月底；NH90於部署最後階段加入，專責反無人機任務。截至11月6日，分遣隊共執行37次Alpha scramble出擊；8月16日，一架西班牙F/A-18曾擊落自摩爾多瓦方向進入羅馬尼亞領空的無人機。
分遣隊指揮官表示，NH90並非取代F-18戰機，而是與其互補：戰機具備速度、航程、強大感測器與快速反應能力，直升機則對低空、低速或行為較不尋常的威脅更具彈性。此次部署屬北約由傳統空中警戒轉向整合防空與飛彈防禦的一部分，結合戰機巡邏、地面防空與反無人機能力。
